title: Sheep holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d="M68 32 Q72 45 55 58" fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="22" rx="11" ry="13" fill="#FF4B6E"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="22" rx="11" ry="13" fill="none" stroke="#FF8FA8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="18" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FFB3C4" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M66 34 L68 38 L70 34 Z" fill="#E0355A"/>
  <!-- sheep legs -->
  <rect x="32" y="76" width="5" height="12" rx="2" fill="#3A2E4A"/>
  <rect x="52" y="76" width="5" height="12" rx="2" fill="#3A2E4A"/>
  <rect x="30" y="85" width="8" height="4" rx="2" fill="#1F1A2E"/>
  <rect x="50" y="85" width="8" height="4" rx="2" fill="#1F1A2E"/>
  <!-- sheep body (fluffy wool) -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="62" r="10" fill="#F0F0FF"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="58" r="10" fill="#F0F0FF"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="62" r="10" fill="#F0F0FF"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="70" r="10" fill="#E6E6FA"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="70" r="10" fill="#E6E6FA"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="66" r="10" fill="#F5F5FF"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="68" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="68" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- sheep head -->
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="56" rx="11" ry="12" fill="#3A2E4A"/>
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="56" rx="11" ry="12" fill="none" stroke="#4E4066" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- wool tuft on head -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="45" r="5" fill="#F0F0FF"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="44" r="5" fill="#F0F0FF"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="43" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="54" r="2.5" fill="#A8FFE0"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="54" r="2.5" fill="#A8FFE0"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="54" r="1.2" fill="#1F1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="54" r="1.2" fill="#1F1A2E"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M22 61 Q26 65 30 61" fill="none" stroke="#A8FFE0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx="16" cy="50" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#3A2E4A" transform="rotate(-25 16 50)"/>
  <ellipse cx="16" cy="50" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#5A4A70" stroke-width="1" transform="rotate(-25 16 50)"/>
  <!-- arm holding balloon -->
  <path d="M50 62 Q58 56 64 50" fill="none" stroke="#3A2E4A" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="50" r="3" fill="#4E4066"/>
</svg>
